The file defines almost no simp-tagged declarations; the findings concern missing/non-reusable simp lemmas that force hand-curated simp sets in coboundary_eq. I did not run Lean, so the effect of adding @[simp] on other files (e.g. whether the Units.map ... toMonoidHom form is simp-normal) is uncertain.

findings.excerpt:
private theorem smul_neg_units (g : AbsoluteGaloisGroup K) (x : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) :
    g • -x = -(g • x) := by
findings.problem: The commutation of the Galois action with negation on units is a canonical normal-form rewrite (push `•` inside `-`), but it is a file-private, non-simp lemma that must be passed by name to each `simp only` call. Similarly, `-α ≠ α` is introduced as hypotheses `hne`, `hneβ` for the specific terms `α`, `β` and fed to simp. The `coboundary_eq` proof thus relies on a bespoke simp set (`hg, hk, hkβ, smul_neg_units, neg_neg, hne, hneβ, ...`) and a fallback `first` chain of `rw`s, because there is no reusable simp interface for `g • -x`.
findings.proposed_change: Move `smul_neg_units` next to `AlgEquiv.smul_units_def`/`smul_units_map_algebraMap` in TauCeti/FieldTheory/GaloisCohomology/Coefficients.lean, make it public and tag it `@[simp]` (LHS `g • -x` is rewritten to `-(g • x)`, which terminates). Similarly make `neg_ne_self_units` a public lemma (stated for any `[Invertible (2:K)]`-field unit, e.g. as a `neg_ne_self`-style simp lemma `-α = α ↔ False`/`neg_eq_self_iff`) so the `hne`/`hneβ` hypotheses are not needed in the simp list.
findings.benefit: Other files already unfold `AlgEquiv.smul_units_def` ad hoc in simp calls; a canonical public simp lemma lets those and `coboundary_eq` use plain `simp`, shortens the case-split simp list, and avoids re-proving the same fact per file.

findings.problem: `smul_units_map_algebraMap` (`g • Units.map (algebraMap K _).toMonoidHom a = Units.map ... a`) is a terminating, directional invariance rewrite, but is not tagged `@[simp]`. As a result `coboundary_eq` applies it by explicit `rw` inside a `first | ...` fallback chain (three of four alternatives end in it), rather than via simp, after a manual `← smul_mul', ← sq, hβ` reassociation.
findings.proposed_change: Tag `smul_units_map_algebraMap` with `@[simp]` (LHS `g • Units.map … a` strictly simplifies to the RHS) and include it in the preceding `simp only` list, so the `all_goals first | rw ...` chain can be reduced to one `simp`/`rw [← sq, hβ]` step. Check that `Units.map … toMonoidHom` stays in simp-normal form (otherwise state a version with `Units.map (algebraMap K _)`-normal form).
findings.benefit: Removes a hand-written rewrite cascade and makes the lemma available to every downstream `simp` that meets a Galois action on an image of a base-field unit (e.g. in Kummer.lean line 144 it is again used via explicit `rw`).
